description_en: We have for sale a 1+1 apartment at United Towers, near the Olympic Park in Tirana. Information about the apartment: • Gross apartment area: 81m² • 11th floor. Organization: • Living room. • Cooking environment. • 1 bedroom. • 1 Toilet • 1 Balcony. Other settings: • Under construction. • South orientation. United Towers Tirana is a modern complex with two luxury towers near the Olympic Park and the Artificial Lake. With contemporary architecture, the 25-story building offers premium apartments, offices and commercial spaces, combining urban living with a unique panorama over the greenery of the park. The project aims to become one of the new symbols of Tirana's skyline. For a visit to the property contact us!
